principle: Optional study events remain in the normalized schedule and are filtered only while generating a student's personalized ICS.

electives.behavior: When the official source contains alternative elective options, all source-supported options are normalized. The student selects the desired option in CalendarPreferences; non-selected alternatives are excluded only from that student's ICS.

facultatives.behavior: All source-supported facultative events are normalized with a stable facultativeId. The student independently checks which facultatives to show; unchecked facultatives are excluded only from that student's ICS.

sourceAssertions.publicationRule: Do not discard B49 because it is optional. Publication remains blocked until its calendar date scope is confirmed; after confirmation the candidate must be regenerated with stable facultativeId values.
